This product GHCVJB0001 CV Joint Boots provides the following OEM part numbers: 43448-12040.

Applicable vehicle models Toyota
Compatibie Models RAV 4 I (SXA1_)/COROLLA Compact (_E10_)/COROLLA (_E9_)/COROLLA Compact (_E9_)/COROLLA Liftback (_E8_)/COROLLA Liftback (_E10_)/COROLLA Liftback (_E9_)/STARLET (EP91)/COROLLA Wagon (__E11_)/PASEO Convertible (EL54)/RAV 4 I Cabrio (SXA1_)/COROLLA (_E10_)/CELICA (AT16_, ST16_)/COROLLA Compact (_E11_)

This is a premium quality CV joint boot manufactured from high-grade rubber material. It delivers superior wear resistance, excellent anti-aging performance, oil resistance, and outstanding sealing capabilities.

The CV joint boot is designed for multiple Toyota models. It effectively protects the constant velocity joint from dust, sand, water, and debris intrusion, prevents grease leakage and premature wear of the CV joint, significantly extends the service life of the drivetrain system, and improves driving safety and stability. The dimensions match the original factory specifications perfectly and the product passes strict quality inspections, making it a reliable direct replacement for maintenance and repair.
